verdict.rationale: Alacritty is configured with TOML and offers IPC via `alacritty msg`. Neither is an in-terminal plugin or scripting system in Lua, Python or similar. IPC and config imports are adjacent controls, not extension in a real language, so the story is undelivered. Scriptability is a fair axis for a terminal emulator, so this is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can extend the terminal with scripts or plugins in a real language (Lua, Python, kittens) beyond built-in options
